findings.entity: framed photo on bedroom side table
findings.description: At 06.00-06.75 the framed photo on the side table between the doorway and window shows a pale yellow/blue still-life or landscape image. After the woman briefly occludes it (07.00), from 07.25 onward the same frame on the same table shows a portrait of a person in a dark suit and white shirt. No one touches the frame; its displayed image changed with no visible cause.

findings.entity: framed artwork on bedroom wall between doorway and window
findings.description: At 06.50-06.75 the wall frame next to the doorway is a small light frame with a compact colorful red/blue/green graphic. From 07.25 it is a noticeably larger frame containing a different green/red/blue mountain-like composition, in the same wall position. Camera motion explains a scale change but not the altered artwork and frame proportions.

The distinctive blue-flower portrait in a dark frame hung on the hallway wall (01.50-04.00). When the camera turns back toward the bedroom doorway at 07.00-08.25, an identical portrait now hangs on the bedroom's interior wall left of the doorway, so the same unique object appears in two places.
